tagline: Over the tops of the Ouachitas on the road Kennedy dedicated.
intro: The byway runs south on US 259 between Page and Octavia, across the tops of the Ouachita Mountains, 23 miles of two-lane road with steep hills and curves, through the Winding Stair Mountain National Recreation Area. On the way it meets the Talimena Drive and then SH 63 at Big Cedar.

The Ouachita National Recreation Trail has a trailhead at Big Cedar, and wilderness areas and the Kerr Arboretum lie off the road for hikers and riders. The Talimena Drive runs parallel, and a backpackers' camp on it looks out over Holson Valley.

moments.title: Big Cedar
moments.text: President Kennedy came to this crossroads on October 29, 1961, to dedicate US 259, then the Ouachita National Forest Road, and his memorial has stood at the SH 63 intersection since 1966.

moments.title: Octavia
moments.text: The end of the byway took its name in 1898 from Octavia Lewis, its first postmaster, and kept a post office until 1953.
